prompt: Create a Python 3.12 employee management application. Employees belong to departments. Each department can contain many employees. Provide CRUD operations and allow users to list employees belonging to a department.

intentions.text: I can list all employees belonging to a specific department.
intentions.observable: A list of employees in the specified department is displayed in the terminal.

intentions.text: I can add a new employee to a department.
intentions.requires: a department name, employee name, employee ID
intentions.observable: Confirmation message indicating the employee was successfully added to the department.

intentions.text: I can update an existing employee's details in a department.
intentions.requires: an employee ID, a field (e.g., name, email), a new value
intentions.observable: Confirmation message indicating the employee's details were successfully updated.

intentions.text: I can remove an employee from a department.
intentions.observable: Confirmation message indicating the employee was successfully removed from the department.
